text: FYI, this place says they value transparency but have an explicit policy against providing feedback after interviews. (They did take my documentation PR after the fact.) text: Kepler | Full Stack Engineer | New York, NY | ONSITE | $230K-$260K + equity We're building the trust layer for AI in high-stakes industries.
